newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MALLORCA SIGN BRAZIL STRIKER PALHINHA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MALLORCA SIGN BRAZIL STRIKER PALHINHA.

text.p: Real Mallorca have signed Brazilian international striker Palinha from Brazil's Cruzeiro for one billion pesetas ($6.8 million).
Bartolome Beltran, president of the newly promoted Spanish first division side, announced the signing on Sunday and said: "Palhinha could be the best player in the history of the club."
Palhinha -- full name Jorge Ferreira Da Silva -- has signed a three-year contract.
The club beat efforts by Atletico Madrid to sign the 29-year-old striker who has played 26 times for Brazil.
